Where to get your Jumbo Template files
:::

There are two ways you can get your Jumbo Template installation files:

- :::: {.text-base .leading-normal .mr-1 .flex .min-h-lh .min-w-6 .items-center .justify-center .text-tint}
  ::: {.before:font-var .before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) style="--pseudoBefore--content:'•';--font-family:Arial;font-size:min(1.5em, 24px);line-height:1"}
  :::

  From Themeforest.net Account
  :::

  ::: {.before:font-var .before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) style="--pseudoBefore--content:'•';--font-family:Arial;font-size:min(1.5em, 24px);line-height:1"}
  :::

  Via GitHub Account
  :::

If you are an active developer or you are the owner and want your
developer to give access to the Jumbo\'s Github repository, this is a
perfect way to provide that support.

To get the Jumbo\'s GitHub repository access for your GitHub account,
follow the below steps:

1.  :::: {.text-base .leading-normal .mr-1 .flex .min-h-lh .min-w-6 .items-center .justify-center .text-tint}

    For this, you will need your purchase code of Themeforest.net. So,
    keep that with you before moving to the next steps
    :::

2.  :::: {.text-base .leading-normal .mr-1 .flex .min-h-lh .min-w-6 .items-center .justify-center .text-tint}

    visit this link to know more about that

    .ml-0.5 .inline .size-3
    .links-accent:text-tint-subtle}](https://help.market.envato.com/hc/en-us/articles/202822600-Where-Is-My-Purchase-Code){.underline

    .hover:links-accent:decoration-[3px]
    .hover:links-accent:[text-decoration-skip-ink:none] .transition-all

3.  :::: {.text-base .leading-normal .mr-1 .flex .min-h-lh .min-w-6 .items-center .justify-center .text-tint}
    ::: {.before:font-var .before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) style="--pseudoBefore--content:'3.';--font-family:inherit;font-size:min(1em, 24px)"}

    ::: {.flex .min-w-0 .flex-1 .flex-col .space-y-2}

    .links-accent:text-tint-subtle}](https://www.g-axon.work/products/github-access/jumbo-7){.underline
    .decoration-[max(0.07em,1px)] .underline-offset-2
